properties.description: Cobalt-containing electrocatalyst studied under different potentials

nodes.name: Electrodeposition of CoCat on ITO
nodes.procedure: Fresh CoCat film electrodeposited on ITO with deposition charge of 10 mC corresponding to ≈100 nmol Co ions per cm² in phosphate buffer electrolyte (KPi concentrations 1.6-250 mM, with or without 500 mM KNO3 supporting electrolyte).

unit_operations.name: Electrodeposition
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: deposition charge of 10 mC, corresponding to ≈100 nmol of Co ions per cm²

nodes.source_text: For each j-V curve, a fresh CoCat film had been prepared, with a deposition charge of 10 mC, corresponding to ≈100 nmol of Co ions per cm².

nodes.name: Thick CoCat electrodeposition
nodes.procedure: CoCat films electrodeposited with 20 mC cm^{-2} deposition charge in 100 mM potassium phosphate electrolyte achieving Co:K:P stoichiometry of ≈3:1:1 for XAS/Raman experiments.
nodes.source_text: CoCat films (20 mC cm^{-2})... deposited in 100 mM potassium phosphate electrolyte at a Co:K:P stoichiometry of ≈3:1:1.

nodes.name: CoCat deposition on Ni foam
nodes.procedure: CoCat material deposited on nickel foam electrodes with amount increased by factor of 30 and roughly 30-fold increased electrochemical surface area compared to planar substrate electrode.
nodes.source_text: we replaced the ITO substrate with a Ni foam... increased the amount of deposited CoCat material by a factor of 30 on the metallic foam with roughly 30-fold increased electrochemical surface area.

nodes.description: OER j-V curves in KPi electrolytes (1.6-250 mM) at pH 7, unstirred, no additional salts, ITO substrate
nodes.source_text: j-V curves were measured at potassium phosphate (KPi) concentrations... ranging from 1.6 to 250 mM... A. Variation of KPi concentration without additional salts in an unstirred electrolyte solution (Figure 1A)... Common Tafel-slope characteristics at all KPi concentrations: At low potentials (around 1.15 V vs NHE) an overlapping and approximately exponential increase... close to 70 mV dec⁻¹

nodes.description: OER j-V curves in high-salt KPi electrolytes (500 mM KNO₃ added), unstirred, ITO substrate
nodes.source_text: B. Variation of KPi concentration in high-salt (500 mM KNO₃) and unstirred electrolyte solution (Figure 1B)... Strongly increased Tafel slope without KPi: For the j-V curve collected in 'pure water' (without KPi buffer, but with 500 mM KNO₃), strikingly different behavior... Tafel slope that is approximately two times larger

nodes.description: OER performance in KPi electrolytes, stirred (500 rpm), no additional salts
nodes.source_text: C. Variation of KPi concentration without additional salts in a stirred electrolyte solution (Figure 1C)

nodes.description: OER performance in high-salt KPi electrolytes (500 mM KNO₃), stirred (500 rpm)
nodes.source_text: D. Variation of KPi concentration in high-salt (500 mM KNO₃) and stirred electrolyte solution (Figure 1D)

nodes.description: High current density OER on Ni foam substrate
nodes.source_text: To reach higher current densities, we replaced the ITO substrate with a Ni foam of negligible Ohmic resistance and increased the amount of deposited CoCat material by a factor of 30 on the metallic foam with roughly 30-fold increased electrochemical surface area... Thereby, current densities beyond 10 mA cm⁻² were reached

nodes.description: Proof-of-principle high-current OER in 1 M KPi, three-electrode rapid-flow system, pH 7
nodes.source_text: In a proof-of-principle experiment, we realized a three-electrode rapid-flow system and achieved OER current densities well above 1 A cm⁻². A current density of about 500 mA cm⁻² was reached at 1.4 V (vs NHE, pH 7 of the flowing electrolyte with 1 M KPi)

nodes.description: In situ Raman spectroscopy for local pH measurement during OER, 25 mM KPi, pH 7
nodes.source_text: in situ Raman spectroscopy was employed to study during electrocatalysis the near-electrode pH at about 20 µm distance to the outer CoCat surface... We observe pronounced local acidification by almost one pH unit close to the outer CoCat surface

nodes.characterization_summary: Operando Co K-edge XAS shows potential-dependent oxidation states independent of KPi concentration: Coᴵᴵ₀.₄Coᴵᴵᴵ₀.₆ (0.75 V), all-Coᴵᴵᴵ (1.15 V), Coᴵᴵᴵ₀.₈₅Coᴵᵛ₀.₁₅ (1.33 V).
nodes.evidence_snippet: Analysis of the X-ray edge spectra resulted in estimates of the Co oxidation states (Table 1), which ranged from the mixed-valent Coᴵᴵ₀.₄Coᴵᴵᴵ₀.₆ state (at 0.75 V) via the all-Coᴵᴵᴵ state (at 1.15 V) to the mixed valent Coᴵᴵᴵ₀.₈₅Coᴵᵛ₀.₁₅ state (at 1.33 V).

nodes.characterization_summary: In situ EXAFS at Co K-edge shows no structural changes with phosphate concentration; potential-dependent: Co-O shortens 1.90→1.87 Å (0.75→1.15 V), coordination number 5→6, Co-Co ≈2.8 Å.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Taking the noise level into account and comparing the amplitudes of Co-O and Co-Co interactions at different phosphate concentrations, the difference between spectra collected at the same potential is negligible.

nodes.characterization_summary: In situ Raman shows local pH decrease by almost 1 unit near catalyst surface beyond Tafel regime; phosphate bands shift from HPO₄²⁻ at 991 cm⁻¹ to H₂PO₄⁻ at 877 and 1077 cm⁻¹ with increasing potential.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In situ Raman spectroscopy was employed to study during electrocatalysis the near-electrode pH at about 20 μm distance to the outer CoCat surface... The intermediate band at 991 cm⁻¹ corresponding to the basic phosphate species (HPO₄²⁻) sharply decreases when applying increasingly positive potentials, whereas the bands at 877 and 1077 cm⁻¹ corresponding to the protonated base (i.e., H₂PO₄⁻) rise.

nodes.characterization_summary: Internal phosphate content independent of electrolyte KPi concentration; remains constant after rinsing post-operation at 1 V and 1.3 V.
nodes.evidence_snippet: After operation at the respective potential, the catalyst film was quickly removed from the electrolyte and rinsed with Milli-Q water, followed by the analysis of the phosphate content.

nodes.characterization_summary: SEM confirms reproducible catalyst film morphology after water rinsing; shows partial CoCat film loss at high phosphate concentrations.
nodes.evidence_snippet: We note that water rinsing or immersion in reagent water represents a reproducible procedure to remove excess electrolyte ions, as we confirmed by comparative SEM analyses (Figure S21, Supporting Information).

nodes.characterization_summary: Co K-edge positions: 7719.9 eV (Coᴵᴵ/Coᴵᴵᴵ, 0.75 V), 7720.8 eV (Coᴵᴵᴵ, 1.15 V), 7721.1 eV (Coᴵᴵᴵ/Coᴵᵛ, 1.33 V), independent of KPi concentration 0-100 mM.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Edge position spectra were determined from the edge spectra by the integral method. The experimental error of the edge positions is around 0.1 eV.
